headline: Deload done right: vert capped, ankle settling
narrative: A deload delivered as intended. Vert landed right on the recovery target and was deliberately capped there — Saturday's Sierra Helada double was even signed off as completing the week's elevation. Time on feet crept a touch over its ask, worth noting on a recovery week, but the extra was easy engine work on the bike and in the pool rather than pounding. And Sunday's run got sacked off in favour of a lie-in — on a deload, that's a feature, not a failure.

The ankle from last week's Puig Campana rolls looks to be settling: absolutely fine on the bike, okay on Thursday's road-edition reps, only a little sore at Saturday's run club. No calf noise, no flags, and that closes out the Build phase with the cumulative push toward Costa Blanca still on schedule. Peak starts Monday with the biggest vert ask of the entire plan plus the long night back-to-back — the night work owed since W36 finally comes due. Go in rested; that was the whole point of this week.
